description: Raw cron stdout/stderr from .state/cron.log. Wake/skip decision lines are structured into dbwiki.*; everything else (warnings, tracebacks — multiline-folded by filebeat) keeps its raw message and gets a log.level guess. Lines have no timestamps, so @timestamp is filebeat's read time: accurate while tailing live, wrong for a historical backfill.

script.source: String m = ctx.message; String lvl = 'info'; if (m != null) { if (m.startsWith('Traceback') || m.contains('Error:') || m.contains('Exception:') || m.contains('failed')) { lvl = 'error'; } else if (m.startsWith('warning')) { lvl = 'warning'; } } if (!(ctx.log instanceof Map)) { ctx.log = new HashMap(); } ctx.log.level = lvl;
